_note: Manually-maintained US macro event calendar for gold. NOT live data — update by hand from bea.gov / bls.gov / federalreserve.gov. Each event carries the gold impact in one line so the board can warn before it, not after. Dates are the release/decision dates (ET).

events.impact: Hot PCE -> Fed stays hawkish -> gold pressured. Cool PCE -> rate-cut hopes -> gold supported.
events.name: US PCE inflation (Oct)

events.impact: Strong jobs -> gold pressured (less need for cuts). Weak jobs -> gold bounce (cuts more likely).
events.name: US jobs report / NFP (Nov)

events.impact: The decision itself + the dot plot set gold's global direction. Statement 14:00 ET, Chair press conference 14:30 ET.
events.name: FOMC rate decision + dot plot
